scope: Mature public OLMoE pre/post ordinary annealing; same55 text subjects, no independent seed population.

definitions.source_change: A minus P; negative loss and positive accuracy are better.
definitions.selection_value: Random-pool damage minus selected-pool damage; positive means useful selection.
definitions.route: Actual full support and weights; other responses endogenous.
definitions.P16: Common parent-calibrated pool of16/64; native pool normalization.
